This is the original printed text (version 1 of 3). The current text is [[Green Leader In Green Squadron 1 (Remastered)]] (PC-E2). Each version below is quoted with its dated source, in date order; bracketed names such as [Pilot] stand for icons printed on the cards, ▲ is the icon for “take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle” and ▼ the icon for “deploy from Reserve Deck; reshuffle”.
* '''Original''' (this page): Virtual Set 1 release<ref name="eh1351-green-0">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/resources/virtual-slips/ Players Committee Virtual Slips, Set 1 release date. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20240920164229/https://www.starwarsccg.org/resources/virtual-slips/ Internet Archive]].</ref>. First published 27 March 2015. Text: “Permanent pilot is •Green Leader, who provides ability of 2. Adds one battle destiny with a Rebel snub fighter. During battle, may cancel immunity to attrition of any starship here; this A-wing is 'hit.'” No errata mark.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Green Leader In Green Squadron 1 (Errata)]]): Players Committee Appendix A update, effective immediately<ref name="eh1351-green-1">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1237555#p1237555 Players Committee Appendix A update, 9 January 2019, effective immediately].</ref>. First published 9 January 2019. The PC card image with this text and the “E” mark followed on 11 February 2019 (Holotable commit 3d6a28d). Text: “Permanent pilot is •Green Leader, who provides ability of 2. Adds one battle destiny with a Rebel snub fighter. During battle, may cancel immunity to attrition of one starship here; this A-wing is 'hit.'” '''What changed:''' game text: new or changed words “one”; the printed errata mark is now “E” (was “none”). It prints the errata mark “E”.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Green Leader In Green Squadron 1 (Remastered)]]): Players Committee card image<ref name="eh1351-green-2">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual1-Light/large/greenleaderingreensquadron1.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/18da9058492b74388cd006f73993e32a5dbdeea7 commit 18da905] (4 October 2022).</ref>. First published 4 October 2022. Text: “Permanent pilot is •Green Leader, who provides ability of 2. Adds one battle destiny with a Rebel snub fighter. During battle, may cancel immunity to attrition of one starship here; this A-wing is 'hit.'” '''What changed:''' the words are the same: the printed errata mark is now “E1” (was “E”). It prints the errata mark “E1”. This is the current text.
